digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix and pytest-cov CI gate
propositions: All three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) currently enable pytest-cov independently, measuring identical source three times and adding runner occupancy without distinct verdict.

Coverage instrumentation adds approximately 34 seconds of wall-clock elapsed time per uninstrumented cell, as measured by A-B-B-A-A-B experiment (median A=511.16s with coverage, median B=477.16s without).

Ubuntu Python 3.13 must be designated the sole primary cell collecting branch coverage and enforcing fail_under=70, while Ubuntu 3.11, 3.12, and macOS 3.13 retain all test tiers but omit all coverage flags.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy all use selective one-cell or one-configuration coverage collection on primary/dedicated jobs while broader compatibility matrices run uninstrumented, establishing consensus precedent.

Workflow contract must enforce exactly four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) retaining both default and integration pytest tiers, with only Ubuntu 3.13 receiving both coverage flags and all others receiving neither.

Pre-merge Verify baseline Gerrit run 31798375024 (2026-08-14 11:58:33Z–12:29:52Z, 1879s wall clock) and post-merge comparison on inedible-subsimious-brahmancow must measure 3.11/3.12 default-suite step duration deltas to quantify runner-seconds freed.
